input.title: KPC-2026-014: Hair Growth Serum Ingredients (Coimbatore)
input.scope: Kesavi Personal Care, Coimbatore plant, requests quotations for 10 ingredients for a new hair growth serum, with first need-by 20 December 2026 ahead of 4 January 2027 production and 1 February 2027 launch. Cold-zone space (2–8 °C) is nearly full, with only 2 free pallet positions and zero headroom at maximum delivery, so the two peptide lines (RM-009, RM-010) must arrive in controlled lot sizes. Quotes should state delivery lot sizes, cold-chain handling, and shelf life at receipt.

line_notes.note: Cold zone (2–8 °C). Net 6M need 140 kg; current max per delivery 56 kg. Quote lots that do not exceed 56 kg per delivery, with a stated delivery frequency. Minimum 9 months shelf life at receipt. Provide temperature-controlled shipping and a temperature log per shipment.

Cold zone (2–8 °C). Net 6M need 280 kg; current max per delivery 112 kg. Quote lots that do not exceed 112 kg per delivery, with a stated delivery frequency. Minimum 9 months shelf life at receipt. Provide temperature-controlled shipping and a temperature log per shipment.
Cool zone (15–25 °C). Min 12 months shelf life at receipt. Max per delivery 175 kg.
Cool zone (15–25 °C), protect from light. Min 12 months shelf life at receipt. Max per delivery 12 kg.
Ambient. Min 18 months shelf life at receipt. Max per delivery 1,093 kg.
Ambient. Min 18 months shelf life at receipt. Max per delivery 1,264 kg.
Ambient. Min 18 months shelf life at receipt. Max per delivery 390 kg.
Ambient. Min 18 months shelf life at receipt. Max per delivery 86 kg.
Ambient. Min 12 months shelf life at receipt. Max per delivery 240 kg.
Ambient. Min 18 months shelf life at receipt. Max per delivery 102 kg.

terms: Peptide deliveries (RM-009, RM-010) must be staggered so that no more than 2 cold-zone pallet positions are occupied at any time, consistent with current cold-zone capacity.
Cold-chain integrity (2–8 °C) maintained from dispatch to receipt; supplier provides temperature logs with each shipment. Excursions must be reported before the goods are accepted into stock.
Shelf life at receipt: at least 9 months for peptides, 12 months for RM-004, RM-006, RM-008, and 18 months for other lines. Shorter-dated lots are rejected unless agreed in writing.
On-time-in-full (OTIF) measured against the stated need-by dates; first need-by 20 December 2026.
Defect rate and certificate of analysis (CoA) per lot; non-conforming lots replaced or credited at supplier cost.
Quote to show unit price in INR, delivery lot sizes, and the delivery frequency that supplier will commit to, so that inventory holding cost can be compared across bids.
Price validity and supply continuity commitment through February 2027 launch and at least 6 months beyond.
questionnaire_focus: Cold-chain capability for 2–8 °C shipping and storage, including logger type and excursion handling for RM-009 and RM-010.
Ability to ship peptides in lots at or below 56 kg (RM-009) and 112 kg (RM-010) at a stated frequency, and the resulting lead time.
Remaining shelf life at dispatch for each peptide and their standard batch expiry.
Source and manufacturing site for each peptide; whether a second qualified source exists if the primary fails.
Historical OTIF and defect/CoA rejection rates for comparable ingredients.
Inventory options such as consignment, vendor-managed inventory, or call-off schedules to reduce on-site cold storage.
Whether the supplier can meet a 20 December 2026 first delivery for all 10 lines.
